newsitem.title: USA: TJX Cos to sell Chadwick's of Boston.
newsitem.headline: TJX Cos to sell Chadwick's of Boston.

text.p: TJX Cos Inc said Monday it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Chadwick's of Boston apparel catalog division to Brylane LP, a catalog retailer of women's and men's special size apparel.
Total proceeds of the sale would be about $300 million, including cash, a $20 million convertible subordinated note and Chadwick's consumer credit-card receivables.
TJX said it expects to report an estimated after-tax gain from the sale of $125 million, or $1.39 per share. The sale is expected to be completed during the fourth quarter.
The company did not immediately return a telephone call.
The company said later Monday morning that if the sale proceeded on schedule, the gain would be posted in the fourth quarter, which ends the last Saturday in January.
The sale is being pursued in lieu of an earlier planned initial public offering of Chadwick's of Boston, a company spokesman said.
